text.title: Perch
text.safe_tag: Tag, you got it! In Safe mode perch fill up on water insects.
text.bite: A perch snapped at you! Swim for the reeds!
text.caught_you: You were caught by a perch
text.menu_sub: Swim the dark lakes, eat water insects, rest in deep water.
text.night_hint: It's night. Swim down to deep water, or hide under the old boat wreck, to rest.
text.intro: Up and Down to swim deeper. Eat the drifting water insects.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Hunt the shoals of young fish, or look for water insects drifting in the lake.
text.no_food: Nothing to eat here. Look for shoals of young fish, or water insects drifting in the lake.
text.about_looks: Green and gold with dark stripes, red-orange fins and a spiny fin on its back.
text.about_food: Insect larvae and small water animals. Big perch eat small fish.
text.about_home: Swims in schools among water plants and sunken wood in lakes.
text.about_winter: Stays awake under the ice and moves to deeper water, where it eats slowly.
text.about_young: In spring a female lays long ribbons of eggs on water plants and branches.
text.about_fact: The perch is Finland's national fish.

year.shelter: Shelters among water plants and sunken wood; moves to deeper water under the ice.
year.young: Spawns in April–May, laying long ribbons of eggs on plants and branches.
